after refresh COUNT result remains 2

checks: AVERAGE returns 3, MIN returns 2, MAX returns 4, SUM returns 6
blank and text cells are ignored; blanks are not treated as zero
formula bars display the original formulas
after refresh all aggregate results remain unchanged

after copy to D2, D2 formula bar displays '=B2+$B$1'

source C1 formula and result remain unchanged
D2 and C1 states persist after refresh

checks: D1 formula '=A1' displays 2

source D1 still shows formula '=A1' and result 2

formula in another worksheet not referencing these source cells remains unchanged
